23:        """Converts PyBaMM symbols into a JSON-serialisable format"""
24:
25:        def default(self, node: dict):
26:            node_dict = {"py/object": str(type(node))[8:-2], "py/id": id(node)}
27:            if isinstance(node, pybamm.Symbol):
28:                node_dict.update(node.to_json())  # this doesn't include children
29:                node_dict["children"] = []
30:                for c in node.children:
31:                    node_dict["children"].append(self.default(c))
32:
33:                if hasattr(node, "initial_condition"):  # for ExplicitTimeIntegral
34:                    node_dict["initial_condition"] = self.default(
35:                        node.initial_condition
36:                    )
37:
38:                return node_dict
39:
40:            if isinstance(node, pybamm.Event):
41:                node_dict.update(node.to_json())
42:                node_dict["expression"] = self.default(node._expression)
43:                return node_dict
44:
45:            node_dict["json"] = json.JSONEncoder.default(self, node)  # pragma: no cover
46:            return node_dict  # pragma: no cover

48:    class _MeshEncoder(json.JSONEncoder):
49:        """Converts PyBaMM meshes into a JSON-serialisable format"""
50:
51:        def default(self, node: pybamm.Mesh):
52:            node_dict = {"py/object": str(type(node))[8:-2], "py/id": id(node)}
53:            if isinstance(node, pybamm.Mesh):
54:                node_dict.update(node.to_json())
55:
56:                submeshes = {}
57:                for k, v in node.items():
58:                    if len(k) == 1 and "ghost cell" not in k[0]:
59:                        submeshes[k[0]] = self.default(v)
60:
61:                node_dict["sub_meshes"] = submeshes
62:
63:                return node_dict
64:
65:            if isinstance(node, pybamm.SubMesh):
66:                node_dict.update(node.to_json())
67:                return node_dict
68:
69:            node_dict["json"] = json.JSONEncoder.default(self, node)  # pragma: no cover
70:            return node_dict  # pragma: no cover
